description: Java 11 removed the java.corba module (JEP 320): org.omg.* classes no longer exist in the JDK. This recipe retrofits a standalone GlassFish CORBA implementation (omgapi + orb + transitive jars) into lib/corba/ and wires it into the Ant compile classpath so FIPA/* and jade.mtp.iiop/* compile and run on JDK 11. Idempotent. Removes JADE-FLAG:CORBA_REMOVAL markers. Invoked by jade-core-rule-dispatcher.
